name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He initially trained as a general machinist, honing his skills in precision engineering for industrial applications. A chance encounter with a local racing team, struggling with complex component repairs, ignited a passion within him. He volunteered his expertise, quickly proving his value with innovative solutions and meticulous attention to detail.

Driven by a desire to contribute to the adrenaline-fueled world of racing, Arjun transitioned to motorsport full-time. He is known for his methodical approach, ensuring every part meets the highest standards of quality and performance. While still relatively new to the specific demands of racing machinery, Arjun is a dedicated learner, eager to absorb knowledge and contribute to the team's success. His flexible nature allows him to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Arjun is of average height with a stocky build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his tools before and after each use.
Often hums traditional Indian tunes while working.
